description: Plugin facts from current WordPress.org data, dated. Use when choosing, keeping or comparing plugins (up to 3, by slug or name): installs, last update, tested WordPress version, PHP requirement and plain warnings, facts only. Premium and commercial ones (Gravity Forms, WPML, Elementor Pro) get their vendor and relation to a free plugin. For vulnerabilities against an installed version, use wp_security.
